section_summary.extract_value: This section presents manipulation checks for a study with 162 participants (N=162, df=1,161). The checks assessed whether experimental manipulations were successful: appearance-focused articles were perceived as significantly more appearance-focused than health-focused articles (F(1,161)=31.62, p<.001), and guilt manipulation significantly increased immediate guilt ratings (F(1,161)=13.02, p<.001). However, both article types primed health concerns, and guilt manipulation did not significantly affect introjected regulation.
